0|75e1056f5c57050415b64cb761a3acc35d91f013|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"sched: Fix softirq time accounting
Peter Zijlstra found a bug in the way softirq time is accounted in
VIRT_CPU_ACCOUNTING on this thread:
http://lkml.indiana.edu/hypermail//linux/kernel/1009.2/01366.html
The problem is
column2: softirq processing uses local_bh_disable internally. There

column1: is no way
column3: to differentiate between whether softirq is

column1: being processed or is it just that bh has been disabled. So
is disabled results in time being wrongly accounted as softirq.
Looking at the code a bit more
as well. As account_system_time() in normal tick based accouting also uses
softirq_count
column2: which will be set even when not in softirq with bh disabled.

column1: Peter also suggested solution of using 2*SOFTIRQ_OFFSET as irq count
for local_bh_{disable
column2: enable} and using just SOFTIRQ_OFFSET while softirq

column1: processing. The patch below does that and adds API in_serving_softirq() which
returns whether we are currently processing softirq or not.
Also changes one of the usages of softirq_count in net/sched/cls_cgroup.c
to in_serving_softirq.
Looks like many usages of in_softirq really want in_serving_softirq. Those
changes can be made individually on a case by case basis.
